items.title: eMudhra's CA keys cracked in milliseconds
items.summary: A critical vulnerability was discovered in eMudhra's Certificate Authority (CA) that allowed attackers to crack CA keys in mere milliseconds. This incident raises significant concerns about the security of digital certificates and the trustworthiness of CAs, which developers and engineers must address in their systems.

items.title: Upcoming critical PHP security release (CVE-2026-109618 / -109619)
items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been identified in PHP, leading to an upcoming release to address CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Developers using PHP should prepare for this update to protect their applications from potential exploits.

items.title: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch back end for TPUs
items.summary: Google has announced the open-source release of TorchTPU, a new backend for PyTorch that optimizes performance on Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). This development is significant for developers working with machine learning, as it enhances the capabilities of PyTorch on TPUs, making it easier to build and deploy models.

items.title: The Future of CSS
items.summary: A new article explores the future of CSS and its evolving role in web development, highlighting upcoming features and best practices. Developers should pay attention to these insights to stay ahead in creating modern, responsive web designs.

items.title: C# now beats Rust on WASM size
items.summary: A recent benchmark shows that C# now produces smaller WebAssembly (WASM) binaries compared to Rust, which could influence developers' choices for web applications. This shift may lead to increased adoption of C# in scenarios where WASM size is critical for performance.
